description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
